action.new_text:
# Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                     (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                     (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    # Check same shape
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate threshold
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if tau_filter < 0 or not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative and finite")
    
    n, H = logp_with_result.shape
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(H)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    
    # Compute weighted losses
    loss_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, weights)
    loss_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, weights)
    loss_no_call = -np.dot(logp_no_call, weights)
    
    # Counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)
    
    # Margins and keep mask
    margins = L_minus - loss_plus
    keep = margins >= tau_filter
    
    return keep, margins
